title: Annual plan pricing proposal
body:
Hi,

Proposal for the new annual plan:

- Starter: $49 per truck/month, billed annually
- Growth: $39 per truck/month for 50+ trucks
- Enterprise: custom pricing

This would replace month-to-month pricing for new customers starting January. Details are in the Notion "Pricing Strategy" page. Feedback welcome by Friday.

Thanks,
Abraham
